result.instructions: Tools for Neon, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my Neon projects and their regions."; "Show the branches of my production project and which one is the default."; "Create a branch called preview-login from main, with a read-write endpoint.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Neon data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run neon_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run neon_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run neon_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. neon_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: neon_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List Neon projects the API key can see (personal, organization or project-scoped key). Good first call to find project ids. Neon API: GET /projects.

org_id.description: Organization id, when the key belongs to several organizations.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's `next` value.

tools.name: neon_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one Neon project: name, region, Postgres version, storage, compute settings and quotas. Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

tools.name: neon_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the branches of a Neon project (main, dev, preview and restored copies). Each branch has its id, parent and state. Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}/branches.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's `next` value.

tools.name: neon_get_branch
tools.title: Get a branch
tools.description: Get one branch: state, parent, logical size, creation time and whether it is the default branch. Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}/branches/{branch_id}.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

branch_id.description: The branch id, for example `br-misty-glade-12345678` (from neon_list_branches).

tools.name: neon_create_branch
tools.title: Create a branch
tools.description: Create a branch in a Neon project, copied from a parent branch (copy-on-write, no data is duplicated). Optionally add a read-write compute endpoint, which is billed while it runs. Neon API: POST /projects/{project_id}/branches.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

parent_id.description: Branch id to copy from. Omit to use the project default branch.

add_read_write_endpoint.description: Create a read-write compute endpoint with the branch (default false).

tools.name: neon_list_databases
tools.title: List databases
tools.description: List the Postgres databases on a branch (name, owner). Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}/branches/{branch_id}/databases.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

branch_id.description: The branch id, for example `br-misty-glade-12345678` (from neon_list_branches).

tools.name: neon_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the Postgres roles on a branch (names and protection flags only; passwords are never returned). Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}/branches/{branch_id}/roles.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

branch_id.description: The branch id, for example `br-misty-glade-12345678` (from neon_list_branches).

tools.name: neon_get_branch_schema
tools.title: Get a branch schema
tools.description: Get the schema (DDL) of one database on a branch, as text. Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}/branches/{branch_id}/schema.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

branch_id.description: The branch id, for example `br-misty-glade-12345678` (from neon_list_branches).

db_name.description: The database name on the branch (from neon_list_databases).

tools.name: neon_list_endpoints
tools.title: List compute endpoints
tools.description: List the compute endpoints of a project: id, branch, type (read_write or read_only), state and autoscaling limits. Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}/endpoints.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

tools.name: neon_start_endpoint
tools.title: Start a compute endpoint
tools.description: Start a suspended compute endpoint so it accepts connections again. Starting compute is billed while it runs. Neon API: POST /projects/{project_id}/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/start.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

endpoint_id.description: The compute endpoint id, for example `ep-cool-darkness-12345678` (from neon_list_endpoints).

tools.name: neon_suspend_endpoint
tools.title: Suspend a compute endpoint
tools.description: Suspend a running compute endpoint now. Connections to it stop until it starts again. Neon API: POST /projects/{project_id}/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/suspend.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

endpoint_id.description: The compute endpoint id, for example `ep-cool-darkness-12345678` (from neon_list_endpoints).

tools.name: neon_list_operations
tools.title: List operations
tools.description: List recent operations of a project (branch creation, endpoint start and suspend, restores). Use it to check whether a change finished. Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}/operations.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's `next` value.

tools.name: neon_get_operation
tools.title: Get an operation
tools.description: Get one operation: status (running, finished, failed), action and timestamps. Neon API: GET /projects/{project_id}/operations/{operation_id}.

project_id.description: The Neon project id, for example `silent-sun-12345678` (from neon_list_projects).

tools.name: neon_get_consumption
tools.title: Get consumption metrics
tools.description: Get usage per project for an organization over a time range: compute time, active time, written data. Neon API: GET /consumption_history/v2/projects.

org_id.description: The organization id that owns the projects.

from.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

metrics.description: Metric names, for example compute_time_seconds, active_time_seconds, written_data_bytes.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's `next` value.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Neon
prompts.description: What you can do with Neon here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_the_branches_of_a_project
prompts.title: Review the branches of a project
prompts.description: List the projects the key can see, then list the branches of one project. Get one branch to read its state, parent and size.

prompts.name: inspect_the_schema_of_a_database_on_a_branch
prompts.title: Inspect the schema of a database on a branch
prompts.description: List the databases and roles of a branch. Role passwords are never returned. Read the schema of one database as text.

prompts.name: check_compute_endpoints_and_usage
prompts.title: Check compute endpoints and usage
prompts.description: List the compute endpoints of a project with their state. Get the usage per project for an organization over a time range.

prompts.name: create_a_branch_to_test_a_change
prompts.title: Create a branch to test a change
prompts.description: Create a branch from a parent branch. The copy uses copy-on-write, so no data is duplicated. Check the operation until it finishes.

prompts.name: start_or_suspend_a_compute_endpoint
prompts.title: Start or suspend a compute endpoint
prompts.description: Start a suspended compute endpoint, or suspend a running one. Connections to it stop until it starts again.
